source_units.text: Dwelling well in her cities, the inhabitant of Sennaan did not come out to mourn the house adjoining her; she will receive from you a blow of pain.
source_units.display_text: Dwelling well in her cities, the inhabitant of Sennaan did not come out to mourn the house adjoining her; she will receive from you a blow of pain.

source_units.text: Therefore you will give away those being sent as far as the inheritance of Gath—vain houses; it became empty things for Israel’s kings.
source_units.display_text: Therefore you will give away those being sent as far as the inheritance of Gath—vain houses; it became empty things for Israel’s kings.

source_units.text: Until I bring heirs to you, O inheritance dwelling in Lachish, the glory of Israel’s daughter will come as far as Odollam.

source_units.text: Do not weep with tears, nor let them shed tears over these things, for he will not reject reproaches.

source_units.text: And you, squalid tower of the flock, daughter of Zion, to you it will come and enter—the former rule, a kingdom from Babylon for the daughter of Jerusalem.”
